cascadeInspection: Compared the authenticated complete Header17 facts with the final DOM, cascade, interactive lifecycle, and twelve fresh render states. One content-height section owns one constrained Ren10 stack, a responsive two-part copy switcher with exactly one h1, one description, and exactly two real CTA anchors, followed by exactly one full-width landscape trigger with one owned image, one scrim, and one play affordance. One ren-dialog owns a labelled native dialog, one loader, one iframe, and exactly one deterministic video while open; media is torn down on close. The dialog is 738px at medium and 940px at large with one 16:9 stage. Focus trap/restore, Escape, close, backdrop, no-JavaScript fallback, reduced motion, light/dark, 44px targets, and 320/390/767/768/1280 overflow all pass. Inline behavior is an ES module with one root document query and descendant-scoped queries. No form, nav, logo, background video, third CTA, duplicate structure, framework code, raw flex/grid skeleton, forbidden palette token, or chromatic literal remains.
